title: OpenAI Admin API key (sk-admin-): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: marker: T3BlbkFJ becomes T3BlbkFK; both segments are byte-identical to the positive (basis: tool-undisputed) and prefix: sk-admin- becomes sk-admn- (one letter dropped) (basis: provider). Twin of "OpenAI Admin API key (sk-admin-): must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of openai-admin-api-key-go-const: prefix: sk-admin- becomes sk-admn- (one letter dropped) (basis: provider). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
